status: Experimental local detector candidate; not a production repair assistant
training: 80 fine-tuning epochs from v3 on the expanded set; seed 7; head LR 0.0001, backbone LR 0.00001
model_selection: Highest validation mAP50 among v3, v4 and v5; development test scores are reported separately.
runtime: ONNX Runtime CPU; local files only, no runtime download or inference endpoint
input_and_class_contract: components.json; normalized upright XYXY boxes; confidence is not a safety guarantee
public_boxes: ../../data/public_boxes.csv; normalized upright XYXY; empty class rows are reviewed negatives
data_rights: New public sources retain attribution/license links. Original online-collected seed-photo sources remain unverified.
limitations: Small, approximately annotated development set; holdouts have been inspected repeatedly, not a blind final benchmark.
Overall development-test score regressed versus v3; storage recall is 3/10 and RAM recall is 0/2 at confidence 0.5.
Component classes do not identify an exact laptop model or authorize removal; matching manuals are required.
No Android/iOS device benchmark, native camera integration or repair-safety validation has been performed.
